g.text: Camunda 8 dual-region on Amazon ECS Fargate
One Zeebe cluster stretched across two regions, backed by one Aurora Global Database.
VPC peering (default) or AWS Transit Gateway
Zeebe traffic through the cross-region NLB · Route 53 Resolver forwards Cloud Map DNS
Zeebe is active-active across both regions. The database is active-standby:
promoting region 1 to writer is a manual failover step.
